Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) shows a small, hypoplastic right lung with opacity and ipsilateral mediastinal/heart shift (dextroposition), while the CT images (Figures 4-5) demonstrate an anomalous venous drainage (scimitar vein) to the IVC. These findings are pathognomonic for Scimitar syndrome (congenital pulmonary venolobar syndrome), which is characterized by right lung hypoplasia/aplasia and anomalous systemic venous return.
